description: Crescent Cotton Mills Limited is a Faisalabad-based textile company incorporated in Pakistan in March 1959 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange since 30 November 1965. Its business, in its own annual report's words, is the manufacturing and sale of yarn, home textile and hosiery items, along with buying, selling and otherwise dealing in cloth and made-ups. The group also includes its subsidiary Crescot Mills Limited, a public limited company in which it holds 66.15%.
headOffice: New Lahore Road, Nishatabad, Faisalabad, Pakistan
